correctness.rationale: Exact neighbor-white count identities for every vertex imply a complete and disjoint structural fort classification. Forcing fails iff the white set contains a minimal fort, via an exact first-touch obstruction and termination argument. Triple-case white-set count explicitly corrects both singleton and two-pair double counting; minimum coefficients are derived algebraically. The standalone exact-rule verifier exhaustively checked 174720 paired predicate/obstruction tests across \(n=3,\ldots,8\) and every computed coefficient. Infinite domain is proved analytically, not inferred from these tests.

value.rationale: Minimal skew-fort obstruction geometry is a reusable exact combinatorial description of a natural dense Cartesian graph family. It yields a closed all-resource cardinality polynomial and meaningful sharp boundaries at three, four, and five columns, the entire distribution of minimal obstructions, the skew forcing optimum and multiplicity, and the largest failed-set and span invariants. It is not a scalar known-value recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
